name: Neutral Standing Display
prompt: Keep <Subject 1> in a balanced neutral standing pose with relaxed shoulders, natural weight distribution, and anatomically stable limbs throughout the shot.

name: Warrior II Pose
prompt: Use Warrior II as the one fixed pose for <Subject 1>, with the front knee aligned, rear leg extended, arms level, torso upright, and pose geometry preserved throughout the shot.

name: Confident Power Stance
prompt: Place <Subject 1> in a confident power stance with feet planted, shoulders open, chin level, and stable posture from the first frame to the last.

name: Elegant Three-Quarter Pose
prompt: Hold <Subject 1> in an elegant three-quarter pose with a subtle hip shift, relaxed hands, elongated posture, and consistent body orientation.

name: Seated Portrait Pose
prompt: Seat <Subject 1> naturally with an upright spine, grounded feet, relaxed hands, and no unintended changes to limb placement.

name: Slow Forward Walk
prompt: Have <Subject 1> walk forward at a controlled natural pace with consistent stride length, balanced arm movement, and stable anatomy.

name: Turn and Look Back
prompt: Have <Subject 1> make one smooth turn and look back toward the camera while keeping the body motion continuous and anatomically coherent.

name: Hands at Sides
prompt: Keep both hands relaxed and clearly visible at the sides of <Subject 1>, with stable fingers and no contact with clothing or props.

name: Product Presentation Pose
prompt: Pose <Subject 1> as a composed product presenter with one restrained gesture, open posture, and the featured item kept clearly visible.
